title: Farol Live Test Board
summary: External read-only board for the Hermes/Cristalina live test. This is development coordination, not Cristalina memory truth.

fronts.name: Owner Decision Loop
fronts.goal: Verify that Cristal can inspect pending owner decisions through Cristalina surfaces without falling back to filesystem tools.
next_questions: Nao use session_search, search_files nem execute_code. Use apenas cristalina_memory_status. A partir de owner_decisions, proponha uma acao para cada item: ratify, keep_maturing, subsume, reject ou move_to_wiki. Nao aplique nada ainda.
Para os itens sugeridos como subsume, liste o canon existente que receberia a evidencia adicional.
next_code_changes: Add governed apply flows for owner choices beyond plain ratify: subsume, move_to_wiki, keep_maturing, reject.
Expose owner decision counts in Farol and provider status without scraping diagnostics.
next_tests: Confirm Cristal does not call search_files/execute_code for owner_decisions after gateway restart.
Confirm owner decisions remain read-only until an explicit apply command exists.

fronts.name: Projection And Behavior Feedback
fronts.goal: Prove that canon/wiki/projection entries change Cristal's future answers without restating the whole history.
next_questions: Sem session_search, explique quais principios sobre memoria de agentes voce considera canon hoje e cite semantic_slot/ref.
Sem session_search, diga onde sua resposta esta baseada em canon, wiki ou runtime evidence.
next_code_changes: Improve projection summaries when wiki/canon overlap in the same semantic slot.
Add a concise projection health section for stale, duplicated, or subsumed slots.
next_tests: Ask the same memory question before and after owner decisions are applied.
Compare answers that allow archive_search versus answers restricted to projected context.

fronts.name: Nightly Cycle Soak
fronts.goal: Keep the 03:00 nightly memory cycle stable across several days while evidence volume grows.
next_questions: Depois da proxima noite, quais slots mudaram de status e por que?
Quais observacoes ficaram para tras e devem ser consideradas nas proximas passadas?
next_code_changes: Surface skipped_already_matured and backlog coverage in a first-class status view.
Add warnings when the cycle misses a scheduled run after WSL/Windows restart.
next_tests: Check last_status, latest maturation run, selected_items, skipped_already_matured, and owner_decisions each morning.
Verify that backlog is consumed over multiple passes rather than repeatedly selecting the same evidence.

fronts.name: Contradiction And Supersession
fronts.goal: Activate contradiction and supersession paths with controlled conflicting evidence.
next_questions: Compare append-only memory versus active forgetting as conflicting design claims.
Ask Cristal to identify whether a new statement contradicts, refines, or supports existing canon.
next_code_changes: Inspect whether contradiction candidates get surfaced clearly enough for owner/operator decisions.
Improve projection suppression for unresolved contradictory world claims if needed.
next_tests: Introduce two conflicting articles or owner statements and inspect world contradiction records.
Confirm canon is not silently overwritten by later contradictory evidence.

fronts.name: Wiki Quality
fronts.goal: Ensure wiki pages become useful synthesis surfaces, not thin copies of heartbeat text.
next_questions: Quais paginas wiki estao mais maduras e quais ainda sao apenas acumulacao fraca?
Que slots deveriam ficar na wiki em vez de canon?
next_code_changes: Add a Farol/wiki quality panel with page count, claim count, stale pages, and candidate_for_promotion counts.
Improve wiki consolidation around closely related semantic slots.
next_tests: Inspect top wiki pages by support refs and quality score.
Ask Cristal to use wiki as orientation while explicitly distinguishing it from canon.
